observed_error: Status: Preparing for write: Querying root privilege: This command must be executed as the root user
analysis: get_host calls prepare_for_write for an OSTree-booted environment. prepare_for_write calls require_root(false) before ensure_self_unshared_mount_namespace. The prior claim that a non-root status query could bypass preparation was incorrect.
correction: Use the fixed bootc command as UID 0 with only CAP_SYS_ADMIN, and add systemd PrivatePIDs=yes. The collector becomes PID 1 in a private PID namespace, so its private /proc/1 and /proc/self refer to the same process and bootc can take its documented PID-1 branch without CAP_SYS_PTRACE.
